description: Fetch Vimeo's trending videos — the "See what's trending" block on the public discovery homepage vimeo.com/watch (nav: Watch). Unlike the editorial Staff Picks channels, this ranks by current viewer popularity. Each result carries title, URL, duration, upload date, view count, thumbnail, and author; the command paginates the trending API internally up to the limit (max 100). Public data needs no login and no browser session.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum videos to return (1-100, default 20). The trending API exposes up to 2000 videos, so the limit is always satisfied; partial=true only appears if the API side runs out of data.
